description: SeismÜK400 / SeismÜK400dig Seismologische Übersichtskarte Sachsen 1 : 400 000 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by landesvermessung.sachsen.de. This map provides an overview of earthquake activity in Saxony. An overview of all earthquakes felt by persons since 823 with a maximum or epicentral intensity equal to or greater than IV is given. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "SeismÜK400 / SeismÜK400dig Seismological overview map Saxony 1 : 400 000" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Karte, Geophysik, Seismologie, Veröffentlichung, Öffentlichkeit, Seismische Aktivität. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
